title: observability-crds
description: The CustomResourceDefinitions this stack depends on, owned as their own release. Strict: an unknown key fails the render rather than being silently ignored, because a misspelled set name would leave a set installed that the consumer believed they had turned off.

sets.description: Which CRD sets this release installs. Both false is refused at render.

victoriaMetrics.description: The VictoriaMetrics operator's CRDs, from upstream's own CRDs chart.

vmoc.description: Passed through to the vendored victoria-metrics-operator-crds chart. Upstream's surface, not this chart's, so it is not constrained here.
